## Install

Close WoW and extract the ZIP into `Interface/AddOns/` so that `Interface/AddOns/Journal/Journal.toc` exists. Replace an older `Journal/` folder; your settings in `WTF/` are kept. Open it with Shift-J or `/journal`.

Use it with the matching server from the [mod-playerbots-portable Latest release](https://github.com/Syntax555/mod-playerbots-portable/releases/latest), which builds the module. The optional [Progression tab](https://github.com/Syntax555/journalprogression/releases/latest/download/JournalProgression-latest.zip) shows each character's Individual Progression stage.

Changes compared to [buildthehomelab/wow-mod-forever-journal](https://github.com/buildthehomelab/wow-mod-forever-journal) are listed in this fork's [README](https://github.com/Syntax555/wow-mod-forever-journal#mod-playerbots-portable-fork).
